## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Sattakkhattuparamakathā* (Kv 12.5) is a doctrinal controversy located in the twelfth chapter of the *Kathāvatthu*, the fifth book of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. The debate centers on the destiny of the *sattakkhattuparama*, the stream-enterer (*sotāpanna*) destined for a maximum of seven further rebirths [Dutt 1978]. According to Nalinaksha Dutt's analysis of the text and its tradition, the discourse counters a thesis maintained by the Uttarāpathakas that such individuals must realize Nibbāna strictly after their seventh rebirth and cannot do so either earlier or later [Dutt 1978]. The Theravāda position rejects this rigid determination, arguing that an adept may accelerate their progress toward the goal through greater exertion or potentially delay advancement through unwholesome actions [Dutt 1978].

SuttaCentral records no curated cross-tradition parallels for this discourse [SuttaCentral]. Computational analysis by DharmaNexus identifies extensive Pali-internal text reuse across 180 matching passages in 21 texts [DharmaNexus]. These include shared canonical formulas with the Aṅguttara Nikāya (*Chakkanipāta*, *Navakanipāta*, and *Pañcakanipāta*) and the *Paṭṭhāna* (*Kusalattika*), as well as structural and doctrinal parallels within other debates of the *Kathāvatthu*, including the *Puggalakathā* (Kv 1.1), *Aparāpisamannāgatakathā* (Kv 4.9), *Sabbasaṁyojanappahānakathā* (Kv 4.10), *Anantarāpayuttakathā* (Kv 13.3), and *Ekamaggakathā* (Kv 18.5) [DharmaNexus]. Textual reuses are also shared with the commentary (*Pañcapakaraṇa-aṭṭhakathā*) and its sub-commentaries (*Pañcapakaraṇa-mūlaṭīkā* and *Pañcapakaraṇa-anuṭīkā*) [DharmaNexus]. Cross-language alignments computed by DharmaNexus with Tibetan translations—such as the *Śatasāhasrikā-prajñāpāramitā* and the *Vinayasūtraṭīkā*—represent algorithmically detected formulaic similarities rather than confirmed historical parallels [DharmaNexus].
